name: Quiz 2.1: Test Your Understanding of the Customer Lifecycle

questions.statement: 1. What distinguishes a "great business" from an "average business" according to the lesson?

options.value: Great businesses have larger marketing budgets and more employees
Great businesses create a virtuous cycle where customer success generates new leads and improves marketing
Great businesses focus only on acquiring new customers rather than serving existing ones
Great businesses end their process after successful delivery to avoid additional costsn 4
Great businesses use more advanced technology in their operations

questions.statement: 2. In the customer lifecycle, what specific activities happen during the "Success to Lead" stage?

options.value: Initial marketing campaigns, social media advertising, and brand awareness
Product development, pricing strategy, and competitive analysis
Referrals, testimonials, case studies, and repeat business from successful customers
Lead qualification, needs assessment, and sales presentations
Order fulfillment, shipping logistics, and inventory management

questions.statement: 3. According to the lesson, what is the primary goal of Stage 1 in the AI integration program?

options.value: To completely automate all business processes using AI
To eliminate the need for human involvement in customer service
To have existing processes fully documented
To increase marketing spend by 50%
To hire AI specialists for each department

questions.statement: 4. Which of the following best describes the relationship between "Success to Market" and overall business growth?

options.value: Customer reviews and success stories become powerful marketing content that attracts new customers
It requires hiring a dedicated success team separate from marketing
It focuses on reducing marketing costs by eliminating traditional advertising
It only applies to technology companies with digital products
It involves purchasing customer data from third-party providers

questions.statement: 5. What is the stated reason for using consistent terminology throughout the program?

options.value: To make the course materials easier to copyright and protect
To ensure all participants and AI tools can refer to the same stages of the customer lifecycle
To comply with industry regulations and standards
To make it easier to translate the course into other languages
To align with specific software requirements for automation
